notes: renderer=skia-software; pacing=60; frame_ms = interval between consecutive frame ends; frame end = first winit about_to_wait after a RedrawRequested (Slint renders and presents synchronously while handling RedrawRequested: softbuffer present_with_damage), observed through the public slint::winit_030::CustomApplicationHandler (unstable feature); set_rendering_notifier is not usable as frame end (AfterRendering fires before present; the software renderer returns Unsupported). BENCH_PACING=60: native Slint cadence (slint::Window::request_redraw; Slint's winit/X11 TimerBasedFrameThrottle uses a repeated Timer of 1000000/refresh_millihertz ms in integer ms: 16 ms, i.e. 62.5 Hz). ui_stall_ms_max = longest gap between two firings of a 4 ms repeated slint::Timer on the UI thread (includes render time of a frame). setup_ms = first frame end since the start of main(). 2 s warm-up not recorded. gfx-images: N Image elements sharing <= 600 decoded textures (decoded once on 3 threads with image 0.25.10, Image::from_rgba8 on the UI thread because slint::Image is not Send); position/rotation/opacity are bindings on the global `t` (transform-rotation, opacity, scaled width/height). variant big: single Image 4096^2 then 8192^2 (loaded before the measure, swapped at mid-window) with pan, zoom and rotation bound to properties set each frame.
version: slint 1.18.1 (backend winit 0.30.13 x11, renderer skia-software via skia-safe/skia-bindings 0.153.3, softbuffer 0.4.8); rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13); image 0.25.10
